timeline.title: A Short History of Best Friends
items: About 350 BC
A philosopher agrees
Aristotle wrote that true friendship is one of the most important things in a good life.
Pooh and Piglet
A. A. Milne published Winnie the Pooh, and the world met its most famous pair of best friends.
I'll be there for you
The TV show Friends began, and a group of pals on a sofa became family for millions.
A day for friends
The United Nations made 30 July the International Day of Friendship.
today: Not in the history books yet. But in mine, the best friend anyone has ever had.

letters.title: What the World Has Said About Friendship
items: What! You too? I thought I was the only one.
C. S. Lewis, The Four Loves
A friend is a single soul dwelling in two bodies.
Aristotle
The only way to have a friend is to be one.
Ralph Waldo Emerson, 1841
Shared joy is a double joy, shared sorrow is half a sorrow.
An old Swedish saying
letters.hand: They all say it beautifully. I just say: thank you for being you, {who}.

facts.title: The Science of Best Friends
items: smile
Laughing together
One researcher found we are around thirty times more likely to laugh with others than alone.
spark
Brains in sync
Close friends' brains react in strikingly similar ways when they watch the same videos.
leaf
Smaller hills
In one study, a hill looked less steep to people standing next to a friend.
clock
Hours of hanging out
One study suggests it takes about 200 hours together to become close friends. Worth every minute.
hands
The inner circle
Most of us have room for only about five very closest friends. You made the cut.
pulse
Good for your health
Strong friendships are linked to lower stress and longer, healthier lives.
facts.hand: Science can explain a lot. It still cannot explain how {who} always knows exactly what to say.

note.title: What we believe a best friend is
paras: We make magazines for a living, but some feel different. This was one of them.
We believe a best friend is the person you text first with good news and bad. The one who remembers the story, laughs at the joke and never needs it explained.
{who}, someone wanted you to have something special. Not a card anyone could buy, but pages full of you: your face, your words, the little things that make you, you.
That someone is {from}. And from everything they told us, you are loved more than you could ever know.
note.wish: Here is to you, {who}, and to many more adventures.
